abstract: China’s demographic structure is undergoing significant strain, characterized by accelerating population ageing and declining birth rates. The increasing female labour market participation has heightened the significance of intergenerational support in fertility decisions. Despite extensive evidence on intergenerational caregiving effects, the interplay between financial transfers and fertility willingness remains poorly understood. Based on data from the China General Social Survey (CGSS), this paper employs ordered probit/logit model and IV ordered probit model to empirically examine the impact of intergenerational financial support on fertility intentions. The results show parental financial support significantly affects both individuals’ desired number of children and the gap between their desired and actual fertility intentions. The effect follows a pattern of ‘initially negative, then positive’, with diminishing marginal returns across different level of fertility willingness. Individuals primarily have more willingness to have one additional child after having intergenerational financial support. Our robustness checks support these findings. Heterogeneity analyses further indicate that intergenerational financial support has a significant effect on the fertility intentions of those aged 31–35, without housing property or with two and more properties. And such effects are evident in families at middle- and high-income level, especially in one-child families, and in regions with above-average fertility rates.
abstract_zh: 中国人口结构正面临显著压力，表现为人口老龄化加速与出生率持续下降。随着女性劳动参与率提升，代际支持在生育决策中的重要性日益凸显。尽管已有大量研究关注代际照料的影响，但经济转移支付与生育意愿之间的相互作用机制仍不明确。基于中国综合社会调查（CGSS）数据，本文采用有序probit/logit模型及工具变量有序probit模型，实证检验代际经济支持对生育意愿的影响。结果表明：父母经济支持显著影响个体的理想子女数量及其与生育意愿之间的差距，且该效应呈现"先负后正"的形态，在不同生育意愿水平上存在边际效应递减特征。代际经济支持主要促使个体增加一个子女的生育意愿。稳健性检验支持上述结论。异质性分析进一步表明，代际经济支持对31-35岁群体、无住房产权或拥有两套及以上住房者的生育意愿影响显著；该效应在中高收入家庭、独生子女家庭以及生育率高于平均水平的地区尤为明显。

title: Does intergenerational financial support increase fertility willingness: evidence from the Chinese General Social survey
title_zh: 代际经济支持是否提高了生育意愿：来自中国综合社会调查的证据

abstract: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) aims to measure inflation. The CPI, published monthly by the US and measured by the price index of ‘All items’, is the sum of the products of component price indices and their relative weights. We analysed the CPI and its component price indices between 2012 and 2023. Based on the correlations between the CPI and its 358 component price indices, the CPI well represented the trends of most component price indices throughout the period. The time series regression coefficients of component indices did not necessarily match the relative weights. If measuring volatility with rolling standard deviations of raw values with 19 or more months time windows, the CPI was less volatile than the core CPI. The CPI is a good measure of relative price changes in most of the goods or services. However, some goods and services have prices fluctuating in patterns very different from that of the CPI. Policy implications include initiatives that focus on the management of macroeconomic risks, early policy responses using the leading indicators of inflation, policies to manage inflation propagation over time or across price indices, and strategies to refine inflation-linked payments.
abstract_zh: 消费者价格指数（CPI）旨在衡量通货膨胀。美国每月发布的CPI以“所有项目”价格指数衡量，是各成分价格指数与其相对权重乘积的总和。我们分析了2012年至2023年间的CPI及其成分价格指数。基于CPI与其358个成分价格指数之间的相关性，CPI在整个时期内较好地代表了大多数成分价格指数的趋势。成分指数的时间序列回归系数未必与其相对权重匹配。若采用19个月及以上时间窗口的原始值滚动标准差衡量波动性，CPI的波动性低于核心CPI。CPI是衡量大多数商品或服务相对价格变化的良好指标。然而，部分商品和服务的价格波动模式与CPI存在显著差异。政策启示包括：聚焦宏观经济风险管理的举措、利用通胀领先指标进行早期政策响应、管理通胀随时间或跨价格指数传导的政策，以及优化通胀挂钩支付策略。
authors: Yi-Sheng Chao Chao-Jung Wu a Independent Researchb Département d’informatique, Université du Québec à Montréal, Montreal
title: Interpreting the United States Consumer Price Index using index mining techniques and its component price indices: 2012 to 2023
title_zh: 运用指数挖掘技术及其成分价格指数解读美国消费者价格指数：2012年至2023年
